title: Edit layouts
unsavedBody: Your changes haven't been saved. Leaving discards them.
compact: Layouts are edited on a wider screen. Open this page on a tablet or a computer.
missingPart: A part that's no longer available
missingField: A field that's no longer available
columnHelp: Shown as a column in this table.
emptyGroup: Empty. Drop a part here, or add one.
propertiesNowhere: Not shown on any layout yet. Place it with Add.
propertiesPlacementHelp: A page that shows all properties shows a new one straight away. Cards and tables show only what you add to them.
cardHelp: What each item shows on its card. Select a part to change it, or add one below the outline.
propertiesHelp: Shows every property and metadata value a task holds.
pluginPartHelp: Drawn by the plug-in from its own values and actions.
fieldHelp: Shows this field when a task has a value for it.
titleHelp: Every task shows its title, which opens it.
holdsTitle: It holds the title, which every task shows, so it stays.
savingBody: Your changes are still being saved. Leaving now may lose them if the save fails.
noticePreview: Shown to someone who can't change the task, saying why.
noTasks: This project has no tasks yet. Add one to see its detail here.
hiddenHelp: Every task's detail can show this. Taken off, it is hidden, and Add puts it back.

regionHelp.header: Across the top, above both columns.
regionHelp.side: The narrow column beside Main. On a phone the detail is one column; the phone preview shows its order.

partHelp.comments: The task's comments, and writing a new one.
partHelp.relations: What the task is linked to, and what it's waiting on.
partHelp.case: The task's support case, when it has one.
partHelp.byline: Who made the task, and when.
partHelp.notice: Tells someone who can't change the task why.
partHelp.actions: What else can be done with the task: move, duplicate, archive, delete, and plug-in actions.

detailHelp: How every task's detail in this project is laid out. What it leaves out is hidden.
shipped: This is the layout as shipped. A change is kept for everyone who sees it.
detailTitleHelp: Every task's detail shows its title.

listHelp.table: How the project's tasks are listed as a table: which columns, in what order.
listHelp.board: How each task shows on the board: what its card holds.
listHelp.gantt: The project's tasks on a timeline, by their dates, joined to what each depends on.
listHelp.calendar: The project's tasks on a calendar, by their dates.

noEvents: This initiative has no events this year. Add one to see its detail here.

eventDetail.name: Event detail
eventDetail.help: How every event's detail in this initiative is laid out, on each of its calendars. What it leaves out is hidden.
eventDetail.shipped: This is the layout as shipped. Changing it makes it the initiative's own.
eventDetail.titleHelp: Every event's detail shows its title.
eventDetail.hiddenHelp: Every event's detail can show this. Taken off, it is hidden, and Add puts it back.

partHelp.rsvp: Whether you're coming, for an event that asks.
partHelp.actions: What else can be done with the event: report, duplicate, detach and delete.
partHelp.relations: What the event is linked to.

presets.heading: Presets
presets.help: Filters, and on a table a sort, that anyone can pick from the list's filters to start from. Picking one makes them that person's own.
presets.dialogHelp: Picking it applies these filters and this sort as the person's own, and they can narrow them further.
presets.name: Name
presets.full: A layout offers at most {{count}} presets. Remove one to add another.

groupings.heading: Group by
groupings.help: What anyone can group this layout by, in this order. Untick one to stop offering it. To leave a group out, pick its grouping above the preview and click the group.
groupings.full: A layout offers at most {{count}} groupings. Untick one to offer another.
groupings.hiddenFull: At most {{count}} groups can be left out of one grouping. Show one to leave out another.

limits.heading: Column limits
limits.help: How many open tasks each column takes. Once a column is full, nobody can add a task to it or move one into it until one leaves; what is already there stays. Leave it empty for no limit.

calendarListHelp: How the initiative's calendar lists its events and tasks. Its presets are where people can start from.

blocks.accordionHelp: A titled section that opens and closes.
blocks.boxHelp: Groups what it holds, with a border.
blocks.rowHelp: Puts what it holds side by side.

sectionHelp: With a title it opens and closes; without one it's a box.

queueItemDetail.name: Queue item detail
queueItemDetail.help: How every item in this queue is shown when it's opened. What it leaves out is hidden.
queueItemDetail.shipped: This is the layout as shipped. Changing it makes it the queue's own.
queueItemDetail.hiddenHelp: Every item can show this. Taken off, it is hidden, and Add puts it back.

partHelp.actions: What else can be done with the item: report, duplicate and remove.
partHelp.relations: What the item is linked to.

queueItemDetail.noItems: Add an item to the queue to see its layout here.

settingsDescription: How it lays out what it holds: each layout, when it was last changed, and the way into the editor. Everyone who can open it sees them; what each person filters and sorts by is their own.

counterDetail.name: Counter detail
counterDetail.help: How every counter in this group is shown when it's opened to edit. What it leaves out is hidden.
counterDetail.shipped: This is the layout as shipped. Changing it makes it the group's own.
counterDetail.hiddenHelp: Every counter can show this. Taken off, it is hidden, and Add puts it back.

partHelp.actions: What else can be done with the counter: reset it.
partHelp.relations: What the counter is linked to.

counterDetail.noItems: Add a counter to the group to see its layout here.

fileDetail.name: File page
fileDetail.help: How a file opened from this collection is shown, beside its picture or beside the collection, once the collection has properties of its own. What it leaves out is hidden.
fileDetail.shipped: This is the layout as shipped. Changing it makes it the collection's own.
fileDetail.hiddenHelp: Every file can show this. Taken off, it is hidden, and Add puts it back.
fileDetail.noItems: Add a file to the collection to see its layout here.

postDetail.name: Notice detail
postDetail.help: How every notice in this initiative is shown on its own page. What it leaves out is hidden.
postDetail.shipped: This is the layout as shipped. Changing it makes it the initiative's own.
postDetail.titleHelp: Every notice shows its title in its header.
postDetail.hiddenHelp: Every notice can show this. Taken off, it is hidden, and Add puts it back.

partHelp.byline: Who wrote it, and whether it's pinned.
partHelp.schedule: When a notice not yet up goes up.
partHelp.poll: The question it asks, if it asks one.
partHelp.relations: What the notice is linked to.

postDetail.noItems: Write a notice in this initiative to see its layout here.

calendarNote: A calendar has no card or columns to lay out. Whether it shows, and whether the project opens on it, is set on the right.

fieldProperty.metadataHelp: This is the initiative's metadata, which is edited in its settings.

required.label: Required
required.help: Whoever adds one has to fill this in, and cannot empty it later. Hiding it lifts the requirement.
required.missing: Required, and not filled in yet.
required.toAdd: Fill in what is required to add it.
required.ask: Its new page requires these, and it doesn't have them yet. Fill them in and the change goes through with them.
